children: According to Reuters, HKET and JPX official data, global bonds came under renewed pressure on Thursday, with the US 30-year Treasury yield reaching 5.4816%, its highest since 2004, and the 10-year yield at 5.196%, the highest since 2007, as oil rose about 3% following a Houthi missile attack on Saudi Arabia revived inflation and Federal Reserve rate-hike concerns.

Nikkei 225 index futures were little changed in Osaka's overnight session, with the near-month December 2026 contract settling at 65,490, up 30 points, while the December Nikkei 225 mini contract ended at 65,475, up 15 points. No Japanese media report on the night close was available; the figures are from JPX official data.
Seoul's KOSPI and KOSDAQ futures did not trade, with South Korean markets closed for the Chuseok (추석) holiday.

Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index futures closed the night session at 24,627, down 64 points. The NASDAQ Golden Dragon China Index eased 0.7% to 5,724. In ADR trade converted to Hong Kong dollars, Alibaba's US shares were 1.40% below their Hong Kong close, Meituan's ADR was down 0.84% and Tencent's ADR down 0.55%, while HSBC's ADR edged up 0.14%.
Taiwan's TAIEX futures did not trade, with Taiwan markets closed for the Mid-Autumn Festival and Teachers' Day holidays.

title: ASIA NIGHT SESSION | Nikkei Futures Steady Overnight as HSI Futures Slip; Korea, Taiwan Shut for Holidays
